subject: PO field mapping, invoice lane assignment, and early-pay evaluation for onboarding
messages:
From: Emily Park <emily.park@orbismed.com>
To: diego.fernandez@redwoodinference.com
Cc: Sophie Mills <sophie.mills@orbismed.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Aug 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: New vendor onboarding — questions on PO header, invoice lane, + early-pay options

Hi Diego,

Thanks for the quick onboarding kickoff earlier. Procurement here at OrbisMed has a couple of configuration items we need to align on before we can activate POs:

- PO header mapping: our AP system requires PO number in the invoice header and a vendor tax ID in the remit block. Can you confirm what fields Redwood's billing sends on the invoice PDF and PO ACK?
- Invoice lane / remit routing: we need invoices to flow to our central AP portal (invoices@orbismed-ap.com) rather than the generic billing@ address. Is that configurable per account?
- Payment terms & early-pay: standard for us is Net45, but we have a finance approval to offer Net30 if the vendor supports 1% discount for payment within 15 days. Is Redwood able to pilot that for the first three months? If not, what are the alternative options?

I'm attaching our completed onboarding packet and our W9 for reference.

Thanks — happy to hop on a short call if easier.

Emily Park
Head of Procurement
OrbisMed
[attachment: Orbis_Vendor_Onboarding_Form.pdf (pdf, 145 KB)]
[attachment: Orbis_W9_signed.pdf (pdf, 120 KB)]

From: diego.fernandez@redwoodinference.com <diego.fernandez@redwoodinference.com>
To: karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com, lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com
Cc: Emily Park <emily.park@orbismed.com>, Sophie Mills <sophie.mills@orbismed.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Aug 2026 14:30:22 -0700
Subject: RE: New vendor onboarding — questions on PO header, invoice lane, + early-pay options

Karthik / Lauren — looping you in to confirm Redwood billing behavior and to propose the onboarding steps. Key asks from Emily below.

Quick answers from our side:
- Invoice PDF / PO mapping: our billing system includes the PO number in the invoice header and a vendor_tax_id field in metadata. The PDF template prints a Remit To block that we can customize to include the vendor tax ID on request.
- Invoice lane routing: we support per-account invoice routing rules. We can set up a header-based rule to redirect invoices to invoices@orbismed-ap.com. That will also set the invoice lane for reconciliation.
- Early-pay pilot: finance has two knobs — (A) configure Net30 for specific account with the backend flag to trigger early-pay discounts, or (B) keep Net45 and enable a 1% early-pay discount applied if paid within 15 days. The difference is whether the invoice due date moves (Net30) or the discount is an incentive on the original Net45 date. For vendor accounting, (A) appears cleaner but requires a short-term contract amendment.

Next steps I'd like to propose:
1) Karthik — confirm what artifacts procurement needs from us to flip the per-account invoice routing and to attach vendor_tax_id in the PDF (W9 acceptable).
2) Lauren — can you draft a short amendment (pilot addendum) for OrbisMed that allows Net30 for Q4 with a 1% early-pay option, or alternately the 1% discount on Net45? We should include a clause to revert to standard Net45 after 90 days unless both sides agree to extend.
3) I'll schedule a 30-min call with Emily + Sophie for tomorrow.

Attaching our vendor onboarding checklist and sample invoice template for visibility.

Thanks,

Diego Fernandez
Senior Sales Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
[attachment: Redwood_Vendor_Onboarding_Checklist.pdf (pdf, 95 KB)]
[attachment: Sample_Invoice_Template.pdf (pdf, 56 KB)]

From: karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: diego.fernandez@redwoodinference.com
Cc: lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com, Emily Park <emily.park@orbismed.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Aug 2026 09:05:11 -0700
Subject: RE: New vendor onboarding — questions on PO header, invoice lane, + early-pay options

Diego / Emily —

Thanks for the details, Emily. Quick technical confirmation and requirements from Procurement/Platform:

- To add vendor_tax_id to the rendered invoice PDF we need either the W9 (which Emily already attached) or the tax ID field populated in our vendor profile. W9 is sufficient to proceed.
- Invoice lane redirect is supported. I can create an invoice-routing rule keyed on the Redwood account ID that forwards a copy to invoices@orbismed-ap.com and tags the invoice lane as ORBIS-AP. That will also update our internal reconciliation mapping so payments linked to that lane hit the right AR bucket.
- Early-pay pilot: finance wants an explicit early-pay instruction block on the invoice if we're offering a discount (so AR teams can apply it automatically). We can include the phrasing: "1% discount if paid within 15 days; otherwise Net45 due." If OrbisMed prefers the invoice due date be Net30 (instead of Net45 + discount), that requires a signed addendum and an update to downstream billing systems (minimal, but takes 2 business days to schedule).

Required items to proceed:
1) Signed onboarding form (we have it).
2) Vendor bank remittance instructions (for our AP to verify ACH).
3) Signed pilot addendum if OrbisMed wants Net30 as the invoice due date.

I'll stand up the routing rule once I have the Redwood account ID (Diego, can you confirm the internal account id for OrbisMed?).

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Head, Billing Integrations
Redwood Inference
[attachment: bank_remit_instructions.pdf (pdf, 18 KB)]

From: lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
To: diego.fernandez@redwoodinference.com, karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com
Cc: Emily Park <emily.park@orbismed.com>, Sophie Mills <sophie.mills@orbismed.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Aug 2026 10:20:45 -0700
Subject: RE: New vendor onboarding — questions on PO header, invoice lane, + early-pay options

Emily — appreciate the clarity in the onboarding packet. I drafted a short pilot addendum (attached) that covers both approaches so OrbisMed can pick:

Option 1 (Pilot Net30): Redwood will invoice OrbisMed Net30 for a 90-day pilot period. All invoices will show a due date of Net30 and our payment terms will be tracked in the Redwood billing ledger as Net30 for that account.

Option 2 (Discount on Net45): Redwood will keep Net45 due date and include: "1% discount if paid within 15 days" on the invoice. Accounting will apply the discount automatically if payment is received within the window.

Other notes:
- We include a short clause to auto-revert to Net45 at the end of the 90-day pilot unless both parties sign an extension.
- The amendment requires a single signature from OrbisMed's procurement and our VP Finance. I added a DocuSign link in the addendum for convenience.

Please let me know which option you prefer and provide the Redwood account id (Diego) and vendor bank remittance doc. We'll enable the invoice lane routing the same day we have the account id and signature.

Best,
Lauren Bishop
Senior Contracts Manager
Redwood Inference
